svg.title: ThingsBoard 3.6 cluster: discovery, ownership, queue routing and Actor handoff

g.text: ThingsBoard 3.6 cluster: discovery, ownership, queue routing and Actor handoff
Consumer subscriptions and Actor cleanup are separate listeners.
Mailboxes, sessions and asynchronous side effects are not migrated.
Cross-node Core or Rule Engine data message
This callback does not wait for the remote consumer,
Actor, database or external side effect.
Broadcast is N producer sends. A wrapper may aggregate producer callbacks,
but never confirms that N consumers applied the update.
ZooKeeper session loss on current node
Peers may have already published shutdown and reassigned partitions.
The returning node rebuilds from current topology; old in-memory work is not transferred.
